that you receive her in the Lord, in a way worthy of the saints, and that you assist her in whatever matter she may…
When I arrive, I will send whoever you approve with letters to carry your gracious gift to Jerusalem.
Are we beginning again to commend ourselves? Or do we need, as do some, letters of commendation to you or from you?
You are our letter, written in our hearts, known and read by all men,
Aristarchus, my fellow prisoner, greets you, and Mark, the cousin of Barnabas (concerning whom you received…
We therefore ought to receive such, that we may be fellow workers for the truth.
I planted. Apollos watered. But God gave the increase.
According to the grace of God which was given to me, as a wise master builder I laid a foundation, and another builds…
We don’t control your faith, but are fellow workers with you for your joy. For you stand firm in faith.
Having this confidence, I know that I will remain, yes, and remain with you all for your progress and joy in the faith,
But as many as received him, to them he gave the right to become God’s children, to those who believe in his name:
who were born not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.

people.name: Achaia
people.line: A Roman province in southern Greece, including Corinth.

translations.web: When he had determined to pass over into Achaia, the brothers encouraged him, and wrote to the disciples to receive him. When he had come, he greatly helped those who had believed through grace;
translations.bsb: When Apollos resolved to cross over to Achaia, the brothers encouraged him and wrote to the disciples there to welcome him. On his arrival, he was a great help to those who by grace had believed.
translations.kjv: And when he was disposed to pass into Achaia, the brethren wrote, exhorting the disciples to receive him: who, when he was come, helped them much which had believed through grace:
translations.asv: And when he was minded to pass over into Achaia, the brethren encouraged him, and wrote to the disciples to receive him: and when he was come, he helped them much that had believed through grace;
